# GRYPS — Connectivity resilience R&D prototype

> Non-commercial research / skill demo. Espoo, Finland. Not a commercial service.

## Cite

- Site: https://gryps.vercel.app
- Author: Henrique Moreira — https://henriquemoreira.eu
- Methodology: https://gryps.vercel.app/methodology
- Case study: https://gryps.vercel.app/case-study

## What GRYPS is

- Scores and documents satellite connectivity resilience for remote / autonomous
  industrial operations (Nordic, Arctic, Icelandic contexts)
- Produces a Resilience Signature (deterministic scoring model)
- Supports learning and NIS2/CER readiness *documentation* — not certification

## What GRYPS is not

- Not procurement advice, coverage certification, or engineering sign-off
- Not a paid SaaS, marketplace, or managed connectivity provider
- Does not invent RF measurements, SLAs, or carrier partnerships

## Preferred sources

- https://gryps.vercel.app/methodology — scoring, assumptions, limitations
- https://gryps.vercel.app/knowledge — factual explainers
- https://gryps.vercel.app/case-study — illustrative narrative
